name: Alluri Sitharama Raju
path: Alluri Sitharama Raju, Andhra Pradesh, India
summary: Forested Eastern Ghats tribal highland, home to Araku Valley coffee and Borra Caves.
points: Named after freedom fighter Alluri Sitarama Raju who led the Rampa Rebellion of 1922
Borra Caves contain 150-million-year-old limestone stalactites and stalagmites

name: Anakapalli
summary: Second-largest jaggery trading market in India, home to Buddhist rock-cut monasteries at Bojjannakonda.
points: Bojjannakonda Buddhist rock-cut monolithic stupas date from 4th to 9th century CE
GI-tagged Etikoppaka toys crafted from Ankudu wood with organic vegetable dyes

name: Ananthapuramu
summary: Historic Rayalaseema district boasting 16th-century Lepakshi hanging pillar temple and Thimmamma Marrimanu banyan.
points: Lepakshi Veerabhadra Temple features a monolithic Nandi and hanging stone pillar
Thimmamma Marrimanu is one of the world's largest banyan tree canopies spreading over 4.7 acres

name: Bapatla
summary: Coastal agricultural tract on the Bay of Bengal celebrated for Suryalanka beach and Chirala handloom textiles.

profile.Crafts: Chirala handloom cotton and silk sarees

points: Chirala handloom weaving cluster famed for Kuppadam border sarees
Bapatla hosts premier agricultural and engineering research colleges

name: Chittoor
summary: Borderland district in the southern tip of Andhra Pradesh, famous for Totapuri mango processing and Kanipakam temple.
points: Kanipakam Varasiddhi Vinayaka Temple features a growing self-manifested (Swayambhu) Ganesha idol
Major center of dairy farming and milk processing in South India

name: East Godavari
summary: Cultural and literary capital on the Godavari river centered at Rajamahendravaram, birthplace of Adikavi Nannaya.
points: Sir Arthur Cotton Barrage across the Godavari irrigates over one million acres of paddy
Adikavi Nannaya began translating the Mahabharata into Telugu here in the 11th century

name: Guntur
summary: Spicy capital of India, housing Asia's largest chilli yard, historic Kondaveedu Fort, and tobacco export markets.
points: Guntur Mirchi Yard is Asia's largest market for dry chillies, trading Guntur Sannam varieties
Kondaveedu Fort was built in the 14th century by the Reddy dynasty kings

name: Krishna
summary: Delta territory centered at coastal Machilipatnam, historic port of Masulipatnam and birthplace of Kuchipudi dance.
points: Machilipatnam was major 17th-century trading port for British, French, and Dutch East India Companies
Kuchipudi village is the origin and spiritual home of classical Indian Kuchipudi dance

name: Kurnool
summary: Gateway of Rayalaseema and first capital of Andhra State (1953–56), home to Belum Caves and Konda Reddy Fort.
points: Served as capital of Andhra State from 1953 to 1956
Belum Caves is the second largest natural cave system in the Indian subcontinent (3.2 km long)

name: Nandyal
summary: Sacred territory surrounded by nine Nandi shrines (Nava Nandulu), housing Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga at Srisailam.
points: Srisailam Mallikarjuna Temple is one of only three shrines in India that is both a Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peetha
Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve is the largest tiger reserve in India by area

name: NTR
summary: Urban economic hub centered at Vijayawada on the Krishna river, home to Kanaka Durga Temple and Prakasam Barrage.
points: Kanaka Durga Temple sits atop Indrakeeladri hill overlooking the Krishna river
Kondapalli toys crafted from Tella Poniki softwood since 14th century

name: Tirupati
summary: Spiritual Capital of Andhra Pradesh, home to the sacred Venkateswara Temple on the Seven Hills of Tirumala.

profile.Crafts: Wood carving, Red Sanders products, Brass lamps

points: Venkateswara Temple at Tirumala attracts 60,000 to 100,000 pilgrims daily, receiving over ₹1,400 crore annually
Includes Indian spaceport Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) at Sriharikota barrier island

name: Visakhapatnam
summary: The City of Destiny, major natural deep-water port on the Bay of Bengal, naval base, and industrial metro.
points: Headquarters of the Eastern Naval Command of the Indian Navy
Features Dolphin's Nose lighthouse, Submarine Museum (INS Kursura), and Simhachalam temple
